missablePolicy: A trophy is only flagged missable when its official description clearly ties it to a one-time story moment or choice. No official description in this list does that clearly, so no trophy is flagged missable. The watchlist in the app names the few trophies to double-check once the game is out.

Every guide below is original advice written from the official description; a step that has not yet been checked in the game is labelled as advice from the description, not as a verified fact.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's own checklist, which the console tracks separately from this trophy. trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts in total. A stunt is a driving or riding feat the game counts — jumps, near misses and similar moments — and the count is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so every stunt you pull off from the start of the game counts towards it. Do not grind this early: play normally, then check the in-game stats for the stunt counter and top it up in free roam afterwards, repeating a reliable jump or stunt spot. Pick a spot with a clear landing and a quick way back so each attempt costs seconds, not minutes.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Go to a shooting range, pick a challenge, and repeat it until you hit the gold score — challenges can be retried, so a failed run costs nothing but time. Learn one weapon type at a time and watch the scoring: gold usually rewards accuracy and speed together, so slow down enough to hit cleanly rather than spraying. Save the hardest challenges for after you have gold on the easy ones, when your aim and the range's rhythm are familiar.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-down aiming mode: activate it when you are facing a group of enemies, and make every shot count, because the trophy needs five takedowns before the mode ends. Pick a fight with at least five enemies clustered together, use cover to line up the first shots, and only trigger Combat Focus when you have clear targets. If you fall short, retry the fight — the attempt costs nothing but the setup.

This is a free-roam feat, so try it outside story missions, when a failure only costs a retry.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Stealth is the whole requirement: plan your entry, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, and get out with the goods before anyone raises the alarm. Scout the store first in normal play so you know the layout, then attempt the robbery when you are ready — being spotted ends the attempt, but you can try again. Move slowly, stay out of sight, and leave the moment you have what you came for.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks travel the roads of Leonida, so watch for one, block it or force it to stop, and take its cargo. The escape matters as much as the robbery: have a fast vehicle ready and a route away from the main roads, because the robbery will draw a wanted level. Lose the heat and the trophy is yours.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl enemies over with a melee drive-by. A melee drive-by means striking from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon, so drive past a group of enemies at speed and swing as you pass. Pick a flat, open stretch with enemies nearby and a clear run-up, and line up the pass before you commit — the trophy is about the hit, not the chase. If the pass misses, circle around and try again.
